Contracts (FROZEN v1.0.0, 2026-10-28)

Letters exchange data only through these files. Each JSON contract has a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) here; volumes and arrays follow VOLUMES.md. Validate any file with python -m shared.validate <file> (cwd = reverse-engineering/). Changes happen only in INT, from the letters' "Contract change requests".

Common rules

  • Envelope (_envelope.schema.json #/$defs/envelope): contract, contract_version: "1.0.0", produced_by {letter, tool, run_id, code_hash}, created_utc, stub, upstream[] {contract, path, sha256}. Every contract except target_status and ledger_entry carries it.
  • File references are {path, sha256}; path is relative to the file that contains it, / separators. The validator checks existence and hash.
  • Honesty gate (#/$defs/quantum): quantum-bearing records require sim_label ∈ {simulated: ideal, simulated: Heron-class noise (FakeMarrakesh)} and hardware: null.
  • Strict: unknown fields are rejected (unevaluatedProperties: false); extend only inside extra{}, params{}, or the open report objects, or via a change request.
  • Frozen vocabularies: placement class free | juxtavascular | juxtapleural; tumor type solid | part-solid | ground-glass; margin smooth | lobulated | spiculated; lobes LUL LLL RUL RML RLL; cell states 0 host, 1 proliferating, 2 dormant, 3 necrotic (4–15 reserved); claim level L0 | L1 | L1′.

Semantic checks beyond the schema (shared/validate.py)

  • every {path, sha256} exists and matches; NIfTI obey VOLUMES (dtype per field name, LPS identity direction, spacing > 0, label values); all NIfTI referenced by one manifest share a grid;
  • anatomy_masks.grid equals the NIfTI header; NPZ keys/dtypes for seed_shape and growth_trajectory;
  • rulebook: every CPT row sums to 1; rulebook_hash = hash_json(doc, exclude=[rulebook_hash, created_utc, produced_by]);
  • quantum_job_record: counts total = shots;
  • certificate: status: fail ⇒ extracted_seed_hex: null; pass ⇒ seed present and S > 2;
  • receipt: Ed25519 signature verifies;
  • ledger.jsonl: index sequence, prev_hash chain (genesis = 64 × 0), entry_hash = sha256(canonical_json(entry − entry_hash)).

Hashing conventions are in ../seedhash.py: canonical_json = sorted keys, (",", ":") separators, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False.
